title: huggingface/transformers PyTorch 2.0 support, Audio Spectogram Transformer, Jukebox, Switch Transformers and more
summary:
PyTorch 2.0 stack support
We are very excited by the newly announced PyTorch 2.0 stack. You can enable torch.compile on any of our models, and get support with the Trainer (and in all our PyTorch examples) by using the torchdynamo training argument. For instance, just add --torchdynamo inductor when
